I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

A few quick things about Heirloom that might help you feel more confident:

All of our roses are premium own-root roses grown at our nurseries in Oregon, not bought from third parties. That means better long-term vigor and no grafted rootstock issues.
We grow in 1-gallon containers with soil, so you’re getting an established plant with a real root system, not a bare root.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors review any concerns one-on-one.

I definitely want to help you choose something that’s a good fit so you don’t have another disappointing experience.
